predecessors.name: Oriental Republic of Uruguay
predecessors.text: the interior of Uruguay, all but Montevideo, governed by Oribe's Cerrito government 1843-1851

successors.name: Oriental Republic of Uruguay
successors.text: the interior of Uruguay, all but Montevideo, governed by Oribe's Cerrito government 1843-1851

ledger.x: February 1843: Oribe besieges Montevideo and his Cerrito government holds the interior.
February 1843: the Cerrito government contests the Montevideo (Defence) government for the country.
1851: the Cerrito government falls and the Colorados rule the whole country.

wars.name: Uruguayan Civil War (Guerra Grande)
wars.outcome: Oribe's Cerrito government held the interior and besieged Montevideo from February 1843; Oribe was defeated in 1851 after Urquiza's uprising against Rosas and the Brazilian intervention of May 1851.

certainty.note: Control of the interior by one side or the other shifted with the armies; the page gives no front line.
